ponto-de-equilibrio.descricao_pagina: How much you need to sell in a month to cover your costs, in units and in revenue. The calculation runs in your browser.
ponto-de-equilibrio.resumo: Enter what goes out every month and what comes in with each sale. The tool tells you how many units and how much revenue pay the bills — and what is missing for the profit you want.

grupos.venda: What comes in with each sale

campos.custos_fixos_ajuda: Rent, wages, internet, accountant — what you pay even selling nothing.
campos.lucro: Profit you want for the month
campos.lucro_ajuda: Optional. Leave it empty to calculate breaking even only.
campos.custo_variavel_ajuda: What only exists when you sell: raw material, packaging, outbound shipping.
campos.percentual: Percentage taken out of the price
campos.percentual_ajuda: Card fee, commission and tax added up, as a percentage of the price.

conta.formula: quantity = (fixed costs + profit) ÷ contribution margin per unit
conta.nota: The margin per unit already subtracts the variable cost and the percentage taken out of the price. If it is zero or negative, no quantity closes the equation.

erros.preco_invalido: Enter the selling price to calculate.
erros.percentual_acima_do_limite: The percentage taken out of the price needs to be below 100%.
erros.margem_nao_positiva: Each sale leaves nothing: the variable cost plus the percentage reach the price. Raise the price or lower the cost.

como_usar.um: Add up everything that leaves the till every month even when you sell nothing. That is the **fixed cost**.
como_usar.dois: Enter the price and what goes out with each sale: variable cost in reais and percentage of the price.
como_usar.tres: If you want a profit beyond breaking even, write the amount. The quantity goes up with it.

fixo_variavel.pergunta: How do I know whether a cost is fixed or variable?
fixo_variavel.resposta: Ask yourself: if I sell nothing this month, do I still pay it? If yes, it is fixed. If it only shows up when there is a sale, it is variable.

servico.pergunta: Does it work for services, not only for products?
servico.resposta: It does. Instead of a unit, think of an appointment, an hour or a contract: the price is what you charge and the variable cost is what you spend to deliver that service.

nao_fecha.pergunta: What if the equation never closes?
nao_fecha.resposta: When the margin per unit is zero or negative, selling more only grows the loss. Before chasing volume, review the price, the variable cost or the fees.
